messages:
kim: Quick heads-up 4e2 planning a small perf microblast 10.1.2. Target window Tue 07:00 PT. Need a short RN blurb for internal, pin manifest, canary cadence, and clear rollback steps. @ash can you own RN copy? @trent ops standby?

ash: Yep I'll draft. Want 1-line exec + 2 bullets + rollback sentence. Keep it friendly for #all-hands copy.

trent: Ops standby. Proposed canary: 5% (15m) -> 25% (20m) -> 100% (gradual). Gates: error-rate, p95, and a quick QA sample. On fail: abort and fallback to 10.1.1 + disable opt-kernel flag.

deploybot: Preflight started for release 10.1.2
```
preflight:
- infra health: OK
- migrations: NONE
- smoke tests: 9/9 PASS
- canary hooks: configured
- quota checks: OK
```

ash: Draft RN microcopy:
```
10.1.2 (micro): batching+kernel tweak to reduce short-prompt tail latency (~10%). No API changes. Pin: 10.1.2. Rollback: automatic fallback to 10.1.1 and disable `opt_kernel` + telemetry off if canary gates fail.
```

kim: Nice. Edit rollback to add the explicit abort trigger: "abort if error-rate >= 1.5x baseline for 5m or p95 >= 2x baseline for 5m". Add exec one-liner for comms: "Perf micro-update; canary-first; low customer exposure."

trent: Ops runbook snippet (drop-in):
```
# pin
curl -X POST https://internal-api/release/pin -d '{"service":"inference","version":"10.1.2"}'
# abort + rollback
deployctl abort --release 67945 && deployctl rollback --service inference --version 10.1.1
# disable flag
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"opt_kernel","state":"off"}'
```

deploybot: Rollout scheduled: Tue 2026-04-07 07:00 PT -> 5% (15m) -> 25% (20m) -> 100% ramp. Dashboard: https://deploy.redwood.internal/rollouts/67945

ash: I'll post the RN here and attach manifest snippet by EOD. Will tag #all-hands-announce when live.

kim: Thanks all. Trent will monitor first 30m; escalate to me & ash on thresholds. Final signoff in this thread when RN posted.
